# Hyperconsciousness (`hc`)

> An encrypted, append-only knowledge store that keeps signed records in sync across devices and lets users grant agents scoped, expiring access through MCP or HTTP.

Written in Rust (pinned to 1.88.0), installed via a verified installer script to ~/.local/bin, or built from source with Cargo; the package is `hyperconsciousness` and the command is `hc`. The repository contains the engine, CLI, MCP/HTTP server, agent skills, and an optional local dashboard called HC Atlas. It is a developer alpha with no independent security audit; APIs and commands may change, and `hc read` does not perform full integrity checks, so use documented recovery verification for validating backups.

## Docs

- [Hyperconsciousness (`hc`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/louis030195/hyperconsciousness/main/README.md): What HC is, one-command install, supported platforms, checksum verification, auto-updates, and alpha status.
- [docs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/louis030195/hyperconsciousness/main/docs/README.md): Two rules for the docs: durable format has zero library dependencies, and limits are documented honestly.
- [Hyperconsciousness](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/louis030195/hyperconsciousness/main/docs/WHITEPAPER.md): The protocol's goals: one encrypted history across devices, scoped agent access, and why existing tools fall short.
- [Mission and repository boundary](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/louis030195/hyperconsciousness/main/MISSION.md): What the repository contains and excludes: records, identity, grants, interfaces, tests, and the dashboard exception.
- [Hyperconsciousness PRD](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/louis030195/hyperconsciousness/main/docs/PRD.md): Product requirements: the scattered-context problem, six core concepts, and the separate-client vision.
- [SPEC](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/louis030195/hyperconsciousness/main/docs/SPEC.md): Normative format specification: primitives, key file permissions, and durable write rules implementable without the Rust source.
- [CONSTRAINTS](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/louis030195/hyperconsciousness/main/docs/CONSTRAINTS.md): The seven invariants of the design, the review budgets, and what breaks the design if violated.
- [EDGE CASES](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/louis030195/hyperconsciousness/main/docs/EDGE-CASES.md): 395 edge cases grouped by topic, their status against the code, and which open cases unblock the most.
- [DECISIONS](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/louis030195/hyperconsciousness/main/docs/DECISIONS.md): Design decisions with chosen and rejected alternatives, from one log per device to the binary header format.
- [ROADMAP](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/louis030195/hyperconsciousness/main/docs/ROADMAP.md): Verified test results across macOS, Windows and Ubuntu, the compile-input archive hash, and what remains to build.
- [architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/louis030195/hyperconsciousness/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): The layer structure from domain to interfaces, dependency rules, and the separation of cloud storage roles from brain keys.
- [Capture context and write receipts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/louis030195/hyperconsciousness/main/docs/CAPTURE-CONTEXT.md): How adapters attach context to remember calls, the context field limits, and the write receipt behavior.
- [Company gateway access](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/louis030195/hyperconsciousness/main/docs/COMPANY-ACCESS.md): Owner-signed member/group policies and signed device proofs gating MCP tool calls, with enrollment commands and group rules.
- [HC as private context infrastructure for humans and harnesses](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/louis030195/hyperconsciousness/main/docs/HARNESS-CONTEXT-PLAN.md): Implementation plan for HC as encrypted context infrastructure, separating harness, adapter and blind-bucket roles.
- [Connect to hosted HC](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/louis030195/hyperconsciousness/main/docs/HOSTED-ACCESS.md): Installing HC and registering the Codex MCP server using an organization connection file, including skill installation rules.
- [Query a trusted node without replicating its brain](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/louis030195/hyperconsciousness/main/docs/QUERY-NODES.md): Querying a trusted node's brain over HTTP or MCP without local replication, with token provisioning and TLS guidance.
- [Optional lexical relevance search](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/louis030195/hyperconsciousness/main/docs/RANKED_RECALL.md): The MCP search tool's relevance mode: BM25 scoring, tokenization, tie-breaking and excerpt rules for ranked results.
- [Using recall from an external harness](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/louis030195/hyperconsciousness/main/docs/RECALL_CLIENT.md): Bounded retrieval policy for external harnesses: query formulation, match_terms, alias handling and evidence interpretation.
- [HC alpha.13: recover safely from stale permission snapshots](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/louis030195/hyperconsciousness/main/docs/RELEASE-NOTES.md): What changed in alpha.13: stale permission snapshot recovery, the optional trusted query-node adapter, and unchanged retry limits.
- [Publishing HC](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/louis030195/hyperconsciousness/main/docs/RELEASING.md): How to publish HC: version bumping, the release workflow, five-runner builds, and installer behavior with HC_VERSION and HC_INSTALL_DIR.
- [HC scalability and privacy improvements](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/louis030195/hyperconsciousness/main/docs/SCALABILITY-BENCHMARK.md): Benchmark results for retrieval, storage, build times, and active writes across 27 isolated synthetic scenarios.
- [Screenpipe backup adapter](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/louis030195/hyperconsciousness/main/docs/SCREENPIPE-ADAPTER.md): How the hc screenpipe archive CLI adapter backs up Screenpipe data, with retention, descriptor, and size requirements.
